make_or_buy_basis: Candidate high-reflectance CaCO3-acrylic coating is confined to exposed roof fairings after a coupon and one-car field trial; PV, glazing, antennas, heat exchangers, walkways, drains, labels, seals, bonds, and service lands remain masked.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: edge seal, heater isolation, and supplier-approved cleaning/protection
material_spec.form_factor: laminated glass cassette with heater/bond/gasket hardware as required
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail glazing specification plus project fire/smoke and impact evidence
material_spec.nominal_section: aperture envelope and bond/gasket land frozen by RFQ drawing
material_spec.traceability: pane/cassette serial number, CoC, heater record, and installation batch

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: No commercial rail-qualified product, vehicle durability pack, fire evidence or released LM3 application procedure is established by the research paper.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Develop/mix trial coupons locally under competent coatings and occupational-hygiene control; do not purchase or apply fleet-wide until a controlled commercial formulation and rail evidence are released.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.manufacturer: Purdue University research reference — no nominated commercial supplier
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
